text: Evening. I'm stepdad to a 5 year old girl, Maisie. When I was getting her into her pyjamas I noticed some little spots on her legs and a couple on her tummy. Some are tiny dots like pinpricks, and a few look darker, sort of purplish, though it might just be the light in her room, I'm not sure. I'd heard about the glass test so I pressed the side of a glass on them, and as far as I can tell they didn't fade at all. I could still see them clearly through it. I did it a few times in case I was doing it wrong. Honestly it might be nothing, I don't really know what I'm looking at. Her mum's on a night shift so it's just me. I thought I'd better ask rather than leave it till morning.
